scope: Create topology dialog opened from the mobile drawer
baseline: Ordinary Cancel click timed out because user-footer z-index 62 intercepted modal z-index 60; outer drawer also received modal keyboard events
fix: Drawer chrome uses drawer token 50 plus 1/2; modal keeps token 60. Modal keydown handlers stop propagation and preserve existing Tab/Escape behavior.
browser_result: 15 grouped checks PASS at 1440x900, 390x844 and 320x640; no page errors and zero mutation requests
behaviors: Tab and Shift+Tab wrap inside modal
Real Cancel click unobstructed for global/category create
Drawer remains open until explicitly closed
limitations: Synthetic same-origin API data drives actual Vue components; no production mutation, server ACL or physical media acceptance claimed.
